verdict.rationale: Docs mention a mechanism to 'Intercept and handle outbound HTTP from sandboxes using Workers' (docs-23), which could be used to build egress policy, but there's no documented explicit allow/deny network policy API. A hands-on HN commenter explicitly states fine-grained outbound network control is missing and it's currently 'all or nothing' (comm-2), directly contradicting any claim of policy-based egress control. Missing for 10: a documented native egress allow/deny policy API, first-party guide showing how to enforce it, and independent confirmation it works as fine-grained control.
